value.syntax: # [doc = " A finite supplied fact for one transition; effects are reported separately."] # [doc = " (´[ROOT-amend:api:node-package]´)"] # [derive (Debug)] pub enum Event { # [doc = " Enter synchronous preparation at the supplied monotonic instant."] Prepare { at : u64 } , # [doc = " Preparation chose a public terminal with the given exit class."] PreparedTerminal { exit : u8 } , # [doc = " Preparation chose a checked inspection."] PreparedInspection (EditionInspection) , # [doc = " Preparation established the empty barrier for start."] PreparedStart (CheckedBootstrap) , # [doc = " The runner found a result continuation with terminal stdout."] TerminalOutputRefused , # [doc = " Observation installation succeeded or was unavailable."] Installed , # [doc = " Observation installation failed as configuration."] InstallationFailed , # [doc = " Continue the retained decision after installation."] Continue , # [doc = " The adapter completed checked construction."] Constructed { result : Result < () , EntryError > , at : u64 } , # [doc = " Check a pending entry against a supplied instant and stop fact before another poll."] EntryPendingCheck { at : u64 , stop : bool } , # [doc = " The adapter reports the actual bounded byte entry's completion instant and outcome."] EntryCompleted { result : Result < TransportMessage , EntryError > , at : u64 , } , # [doc = " A final check just before authorizing notification."] ReadyChecked { at : u64 , stop : bool , checked_failure : bool } , # [doc = " The adapter reports the one send outcome and facts first observed after authorization."] NotificationCompleted { sent : bool , at : u64 , stop : bool , checked_failure : bool , } , # [doc = " A supported graceful stop at the supplied instant."] Stop { at : u64 } , # [doc = " An internal driver fault at the supplied instant."] DriverFault { at : u64 } , # [doc = " A checked runtime or adapter failure at the supplied instant."] RuntimeFailure { at : u64 } , # [doc = " Endpoint setup failed after checked construction, before dispatch."] EndpointSetupFailed { at : u64 } , # [doc = " The one cancellable future settled or reached its retained drain bound."] WorkSettled { at : u64 , complete : bool } , # [doc = " Owned work and resources have been settled, with a checked release result."] Retired { at : u64 , cleanup_failed : bool } , # [doc = " The shared runner finished its output and observation scope."] Finalized , }
